Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

• Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• ETL and Database technologies.

• Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. **The Impact You'll Make

**Do you enjoy turning complex technical data into insights that drive better products and smarter decisions? Are you passionate about combining data science with engineering and domain expertise to solve real-world challenges? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

As our Lead Engineer, Data Science, you’ll play a key role in transforming product, sensor and operational data into meaningful insights that support innovation, energy efficiency and data-driven decision-making across Danfoss Climate Solutions.

Working closely with business teams, engineers and data platform specialists, you’ll combine strong analytical capabilities with engineering and domain knowledge to identify high-value opportunities, shape AI and analytics use cases and help build a robust, AI-ready data foundation for future intelligent solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Translate complex business and engineering challenges into analytical questions, data-driven models and actionable insights

• Analyze product, sensor, device and operational data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities for performance and energy optimization

• Apply engineering and domain knowledge to shape high-value data science and AI use cases, including feature definition, hypothesis development and validation strategies

• Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to improve data quality, accessibility and usability across analytics and data products

• Contribute to semantic models and knowledge graph capabilities that capture relationships between sensors, devices, assets and their operational context

• Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders, helping turn analytical findings into practical business actions

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong foundation in thermodynamics and physics, with the ability to apply first-principles reasoning to heating and cooling systems and processes

• Experience in data science, applied analytics or similar roles within a technical, industrial or engineering environment

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Python and SQL and the ability to translate engineering insight into data-driven models

• Good understanding of modern data and ML environments, including cloud platforms and the machine learning lifecycle

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data and business teams

• Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, heating/cooling, energy systems or industrial operational data is considered a strong advantage

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Job Description

Do you want to turn cybersecurity challenges into practical automation that makes security operations faster and more consistent? As our IT Security Specialist – Automation, you will take ownership of developing our security automation capabilities and help shape how we work with SOAR at JYSK.

You will join JYSK Head Office in Aarhus and work closely with colleagues across our security team. This is an opportunity to combine cybersecurity, automation and hands-on problem-solving in a role where you can take an idea from identifying an opportunity to implementing a working solution.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

As an IT Security Engineer, you will become part of a collaborative team that works with modern tools and methods to improve JYSK’s security posture. You will also benefit from a strong focus on your personal and professional development through structured learning and collaboration with colleagues across IT and the wider business.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A young, dynamic team dedicated to IT security and cyber defence

• A healthy work-life-balance supported by a flexible work-from-home policy

• Opportunities to work on passion projects alongside your core responsibilities

• A relaxed, open-minded working environment with collaboration opportunities across all levels of the organisation

• Attractive staff benefits and discounts within the Lars Larsen Group

• Freshly prepared breakfast and lunch served daily by our canteen

• Tailored training and courses to support your development and career path

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You will take ownership of the implementation, development and day-to-day operation of our security automation platform, from initial setup to continuous improvement. Working closely with the security team, you will identify opportunities for automation, understand operational needs and turn them into practical and reliable security workflows.

A key part of your role will be driving our SOAR journey forward. You will have room to take initiative, challenge existing ways of working and identify where automation can reduce manual effort and improve the consistency of our security operations.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Design, build, test and maintain SOAR playbooks and automated response workflows for security incidents and operational processes

• Improve and streamline incident response processes to reduce manual work and enable faster, more consistent responses

• Integrate the SOAR platform with security tools and data sources, including SIEM, EDR, identity, threat intelligence and ticketing systems

• Monitor, troubleshoot and continuously improve existing security automations to keep them reliable, maintainable and fit for purpose

• Work with the security team to identify automation opportunities and translate operational requirements into effective workflows

• Drive security automation initiatives from idea to implementation and proactively identify what should be automated next

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You may already have experience from cybersecurity, security operations or incident response and now want to specialise further in security automation. More important is your ability to take ownership, learn quickly and turn technical challenges into solutions that work in practice.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity, preferably within security operations, incident response, SIEM or security automation

• Takes ownership and works independently, with the ability to move a challenge forward without needing every step defined

• Has a practical and curious approach to understanding how systems and processes work and translating requirements into solutions

• Has experience with, or a strong interest in, SOAR platforms, security automation, scripting and system integrations

• Has experience with Python or a similar scripting language, or is motivated to develop these skills further

• Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues and is comfortable driving initiatives across a security team

• Takes initiative, learns quickly and is motivated by building new solutions and improving existing ways of working

• Providing professional support and guidance to employees and managers on payroll and compliance matters

• Handling absence-related tasks and communicating relevant information to employees and managers

• Administering payroll and employee benefit matters related to employee absence

• You can communicate fluently in Danish and English

• You have experience working with payroll in a manufacturing environment and understand the specific requirements associated with this type of organization

• You have hands-on experience with time registration, absence management, and payroll processes

• You work in a structured and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on accuracy and quality

• You are service-minded and motivated by supporting employees and managers

• You have strong communication and collaboration skills and are comfortable working with stakeholders across the organization

• You are confident working with payroll data, reporting, and analyses

The position is based at KK Group’s location in Hammel.

**Domain Architect - E-Commerce, Retail and MarTech

**Transform Our Technological Vision at Pandora

**Pandora is on a mission to enhance its retail and e-commerce systems, creating seamless customer experiences and driving growth. As the Domain Architect in Retail and E-commerce, you will be instrumental in shaping our architectural strategy and guiding cross-functional teams to implement innovative solutions. This is your chance to make a significant impact on Pandora’s technological landscape and drive our ambitious goals forward.

**Key Responsibilities

****Architectural Planning & Governance:

**

• Collaborate with the Engineering Director to develop and implement a detailed architectural strategy.

• Ensure alignment between architecture planning and business goals across product lines.

• Lead architectural governance processes and facilitate effective decision-making.

**Leadership Of Architecture & Engineering Teams

**

• Directly manage Solution and Technical Architects, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.

• Mentor team members to promote professional growth and skill development.

**System Design & Implementation

**

• Design end-to-end solutions for retail and e-commerce platforms.

• Gather system requirements from stakeholders to ensure technical feasibility.

• Evaluate and recommend technologies that enhance performance, security, and scalability.

**Collaboration & Communication

**

• Work with cross-functional teams to ensure cohesive implementation of architectural solutions.

• Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders effectively.

**Key Qualifications

****What You Bring to the Team

**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing scalable retail and e-commerce systems.

• Proven leadership skills, with experience managing teams of 5-10.

• Strong knowledge of relevant technologies, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud and cloud-based solutions like Azure.

• Familiarity with Order Management Systems and retail POS platforms.

• Experience with DevOps practices and tools.

• Excellent communication skills in English.

**Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

What To Expect At Dalux

At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**

• On FCP: This role brings centralised ownership and direction, consolidating what already exists, formalising it into clear Standard Operating Procedures, and training the relevant teams on them ahead of go-live.

• Concrete early priorities include standing up transaction monitoring and fraud detection, locking v1.0 of the policy suite (Sanctions, PEP, EDD, Outsourcing, and the Sanction-Screening and SAR/STR filing SOPs) into the Centralised Policy Register, building the regulatory-reporting data structure and CESOP readiness, finalising KYC/KYB (EU + US), and securing your Finanstilsynet fit & proper approval ahead of go-live. A structured focus-areas plan accompanies this role.

**Requirements

**

Comparable experience in public authorities, AML consulting, or other AML-regulated sectors (for example gaming/gambling) will also be considered.

• Strong, current understanding of Danish AML law (Hvidvaskloven) and the EU framework (AMLD/AMLR, EBA guidelines), plus sanctions regimes. Awareness of the incoming EU AML package (AMLR + AMLD6, applying July 2027) is a plus.

• Eligibility to pass a Finanstilsynet fit & proper assessment. Prior approval in a fit & proper / key-function role at an EU financial institution is a strong advantage.

• Experience across risk controls, compliance, the payments area, credit management, or lines-of-defence leadership. Fintech/scale-up experience is a plus.
